text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
陛下、気分転換などいかがでしょう？
面白い試合が行われるとの噂を耳にしました。
text.official_en:
For a change of pace, Your Majesty, would you like
to attend an interesting match I've heard tell of?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
なんでも、一般にはまったく告知されていない、
秘密の御前試合なのだそうです。
text.official_en:
Apparently, it is a private and exclusive bout,
not announced to the general public.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
詳細は不明ながら、なんでも、
例の白髪鬼が出場するとか……
text.official_en:
Details are scant, but I have gleaned that the
White-Maned Demon will be taking part.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
取り仕切っているのは、闘技場の管理官の
ベラフィという男です。
text.official_en:
A man named Poloni, who serves as the arena's
commissioner, is coordinating it.
text.real_en:
A man named Verafi, who serves as the arena's
commissioner, is coordinating it.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
お望みなら、奴に観戦の要求を
通すことはおそらく可能と思われます。
text.official_en:
If you are interested, it should be simple enough to
get him to approve us as spectators.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
その御前試合が行われるのは
４月６日の１８時からだそうです。
text.official_en:
This exhibition match will take place on Efraul 6 at
6:00 PM.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
もしも当日に都合がつきましたらば、
会場となる水晶宮に向かうことにしましょう。
text.official_en:
If our schedule permits it, let us be sure to remember
to visit the Crystal Palace, the venue for the match.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
白髪鬼はこの都市でもひときわ高い人気を誇る、
いうなれば戦士の中の戦士。
text.official_en:
The White-Maned Demon is one of the most popular
combatants. He is a warrior among warriors.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
陛下にとり、きっとよい気晴らしと
なることでしょう。
text.official_en: I am certain Your Majesty will enjoy the sight of it.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
さて……次回の彼奴めの襲撃に備え、
万全の支度を済ませませぬとな。
text.official_en:
Now then, we must ensure we are fully prepared for
him to strike again.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あの男をこれ以上野放しにする訳にはいきませぬ。
ここできっちりと仕留めてしまいましょう。
text.official_en:
This rabid dog cannot be allowed to run loose any
longer. Let us put him out of our misery.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トビヤス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
うーむ。さすがに
いくらかは慣れてきたとはいえ、
text.official_en:
Y'know...I had thought I was getting used to
this place.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トビヤス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ここに着いてからというもの、
首を回しすぎて肩が凝ってきたわい。
text.official_en:
But I'm still craning my neck to see something wild
every five seconds, and it's givin' me a crick.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トビヤス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ボナのやつは毎日しかめっつらで
あちこちを行ったり来たりしておるし。
text.official_en:
And Bona's got it even worse! He spends every day
walking around with a big ol' frown.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トビヤス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
まあ、ワシは、うまい酒さえ手に入るなら
どこでも大抵、不満はないがのー。
text.official_en:
But I can't complain, so long as I can relax in the
evenings with some good ale.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リリアン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
バーン・バーンって、ダヤンさまの依頼で、
陛下を襲撃したハル・ハリ族の族長ですよね？
text.official_en:
This Bahr Vahn guy is the Har Hali chief that
Prince Dyan sicced on you, right?
text.real_en:
This Baan-Baan guy is the Har-Hari chief that
Dayan-sama sicced on you, right?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リリアン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あいつ……前回試合で戦った時より
ずっと、危ない感じしましたケド……
text.official_en:
He seemed way more dangerous than when we went
up against him in the arena...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リリアン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
………………
そりゃ、アタシも怖いですよ、当然。
text.official_en: Am I scared? Of course.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リリアン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
なんたって、この世の中で一番怖いのは、
何考えてるかわからない相手なんですから。
text.official_en:
Nothing in the world is creepier than someone who
you can't figure out.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リリアン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
だから、ちゃんとあいつを仕留めたら
お手当の方、はずんでくださいねー？
text.official_en:
While I've got you here—if I get the kill on him,
is there a bonus in it?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ライサンダー
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あの日以来、バーン・バーンの姿は
ダグシオンから消えているようです。
text.official_en: Bahr Vahn seems to have vanished from Dagsion.
text.real_en: Baan-Baan seems to have vanished from Dagsion.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ライサンダー
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
おそらく、どこかに隠れて
体力を回復させているのでしょうが……
text.official_en:
I don't doubt that he's gone into hiding to recover
his strength.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ライサンダー
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
不思議です。今の奴は
かなり人目につく風体だと思うのですが、
text.official_en:
But a man like that would be rather conspicuous,
you'd think...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ライサンダー
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
この人間の多い街の中で、奴は一体
どこに潜んでいるというのでしょう。
text.official_en: Where could he possibly hide in this teeming city?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
現在、サラミスの兵士たちも総力を挙げて
バーン・バーンの追跡を行っております。
text.official_en:
Every Saraminian soldier here is mobilizing to pursue
Bahr Vahn.
text.real_en:
Every Saraminian soldier here is mobilizing to pursue
Baan-Baan.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
彼らと共に彼奴を追跡し、
今日こそは息の根を止めてしまいましょう！
text.official_en:
Let us join them to hunt him down and end his
campaign of terror!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トビヤス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
いかん、さっきまでそこにいたのに見失ったー！
相変わらず、恐ろしくすばしっこいやつだー！
text.official_en:
Damn it! He was right there, and I lost him. That
guy's one slippery customer.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トビヤス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
お嬢、多分もう奴はこのへんにはおらん！
とっとと他の場所を探さんと！
text.official_en:
He's probably long gone from here, boss. Let's go
shake the trees and see what falls out!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リリアン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……陛下、見てください。
ここに血の跡が。それも、まだ新しい……
text.official_en: Check it out, Your Majesty. This blood trail's fresh.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リリアン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……多分ですケド、アイツが
この先にいるのは間違いないと思います。
text.official_en: No guarantees, but I'd bet he's up ahead.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ライサンダー
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
陛下！　あそこに、
やつを目撃したものがいるようです！
text.official_en: Your Majesty! We've turned up a witness.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ライサンダー
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
まだそう遠くには行っていないはず……
すぐに追跡しましょう！
text.official_en: He can't be far. Let's drive him out of hiding!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_コウカ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
次の満月の日……
本当に奴は現れるというのか……？
text.official_en: You're sure he'll show his face at the next full moon?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_コウカ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
もしそうなら、協力して奴を討ちとりたい。
前日の<#CTRL:0E>
text.official_en:
If so, I would like your help defeating him. Come find
me on the day before, <#CTRL:0E>

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_コウカ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ついに今晩は満月だな。
本当に奴は現れるというのか……？
text.official_en:
Tonight is the full moon at last. Will he show
his face?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_コウカ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
もしそうなら、協力して奴を討ちとりたい。
準備ができたら、指示をしてくれ。
text.official_en:
If so, I would like your help defeating him. Come find
me again once you're ready.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
セオドラ様ですね。
現在、特別試合を開催しております。
text.official_en:
You are Queen Theodora, yes? We are currently
holding an exhibition match.

text.jp:
お話は伺っております。
観戦していかれますか？
text.official_en:
I was told you might attend. Would you like to watch
the match?

text.jp: <ICA>はい
text.official_en: <ICA>Say yes.

text.jp: <ICB>いいえ
text.official_en: <ICB>Say no.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
ここを抜かれました……
やつはそのまま……神殿に……
text.official_en: He got past us... Went straight into the temple...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
神殿……まさかユ・ファス神殿か！
皆のもの、行くぞ！
text.official_en:
"The temple"? You mean the temple of Yu Phas?!
Quickly, everyone!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
陛下！　バーン・バーンめは
こちらには来ておりません！
text.official_en: No sign of Bahr Vahn this way, Your Majesty.
text.real_en: No sign of Baan-Baan this way, Your Majesty.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
奴はここを通り抜けて行ったようです！
人間とは思えない動きでした。
text.official_en:
It looks like he passed this way. The way he moved,
though... It was inhuman.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
異様な声が聞こえた直後に恐ろしい男が
飛び出して来て腰を抜かしそうになりました。
text.official_en:
I heard a strange voice, and right after that an
awful-looking man rushed past. I nearly fainted.

text.jp:
あいつは、私達には目もくれず、
参道方向へ行ってしまいました。
text.official_en:
Luckily, he didn't seem to notice us and headed
toward Temple Row.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
ケガをした大きな男でしたら
神殿の方向へ走っていくのを見ましたが……
text.official_en:
If it's a big wounded guy you're looking for, I saw
him running toward the temples.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
お待たせいたしました、トラファルガー号の
整備が無事に完了いたしました。
text.official_en:
The Trafalgar's repairs have been completed. Very
sorry for the wait.

text.jp:
船を利用することで、
水上の移動が可能となります。
text.official_en: Your ship is ready to set sail again.
